environment.description: Laravel 10 application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. Redis ElastiCache cluster (version 7.x) with AUTH token enabled. The application connects to Aurora PostgreSQL using a dedicated IAM-authenticated database role 'ro_config_reader' provisioned via terraform-aws-modules/rds with a custom parameter group. The PostgreSQL role has been granted through a restricted privilege model: GRANT SELECT ON app_settings TO ro_config_reader; with no additional DML privileges. The role is further constrained by a row-level security policy that filters on current_setting('app.tenant_id'). Cache backend uses Redis with key-prefix isolation per ECS task-family. Note: the updateConfig and warmCache endpoints are still routed but the DB connection pool for this service tier exclusively uses the ro_config_reader role credential rotated via AWS Secrets Manager with 7-day rotation schedule.

config.db_privileges: SELECT ON app_settings (enforced via PostgreSQL GRANT, no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE)
